definitions.explanation: Items used in an office setting, such as pens, paper, folders, staplers, and other stationery and desk supplies.

examples.japanese: {事務|じむ}{用品|ようひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
{事務|じむ}{用品|ようひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ロッカー→ロッカー：09734_rokkaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}している→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧。
examples.english: Office supplies are kept together in a locker.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新入|しんにゅう}{社員|しゃいん}→新入社員：15536_shinnyuushain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{事務|じむ}{用品|ようひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一式|いっしき}→一式：15714_isshiki⟧⟦{揃|そろ}えた→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧。
examples.english: I prepared a full set of office supplies for the new employee.

notes:
USAGE:
A practical compound word used in workplace settings. Often seen in office supply stores, procurement lists, and workplace management.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事務|じむ}{用品|ようひん}⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (office supply store)
- {事務|じむ}{用品|ようひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to purchase office supplies)
- {事務|じむ}{用品|ようひん}⟦{一式|いっしき}→一式：15714_isshiki⟧ (a set of office supplies)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{文房具|ぶんぼうぐ}→文房具：12869_bunbougu⟧: stationery — pens, notebooks, etc. (for personal/school use too)
- {事務|じむ}{用品|ようひん}: office supplies — specifically for office/workplace use
